caption_L1: Here a bar chart is titled Number of think tanks in the Caribbean in 2018 , by country or territory. The x-axis plots Country as categorical scale from Antigua and Barbuda to Trinidad and Tobago while the y-axis plots Number of think tanks with linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 40.
caption_L2L3: Grenada, Montserrat and St. Kitts and Nevis have the lowest number of think tanks, whilst the Dominican Republic has the highest, which is significantly more than the rest of the Caribbean. Most countries have fewer than 10 think tanks and the only country with more than 20 but less than 30 is Cuba.
